stories.headline: Milwaukee sweep the Dodgers to reach the World Series
stories.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have swept the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series. It takes them to the World Series for the first time since 1982. They came from behind in all four games, the first team to sweep a best-of-seven postseason series that way.

stories.headline: UniCredit is cleared to take control of Commerzbank
stories.summary: The European Central Bank has given UniCredit permission to raise its stake in Commerzbank beyond 30%, with no limit on how much it could own. The Italian bank's takeover bid had already taken it to 47.6% of the German lender by July 2026. It expects to take control by the end of the year.

stories.headline: The biggest crayfish turns up in a museum collection
stories.summary: A biologist pulled an unusually large Crawzilla crawdad out of the mud during a biological survey in Kentucky. That started a search through preserved collections for the biggest crayfish anyone had kept. The list came to 20 very large specimens from 18 different species.
